you.title: This is you
you.body:
Walk with W A S D, or click a spot on the floor.
Click your character to change your look.

sit.title: Sit, relax, play
sit.body:
Click a free chair, sofa or beanbag to sit down — press E to get up.
Click the arcade cabinet to play Snake, Breakout, Flappy or 2048.
Walk out the door in the back wall to reach the lobby.

agents.title: Your agents
agents.body: Live shows the Claude Code sessions you run in a terminal, as characters at the desks. Demo plays a sample team so you can look around first.

wallet.title: Coins and the shop
wallet.body: Every reply an agent finishes earns you coins (+10, plus a bonus for tools, up to 500 a day). Click here to buy outfits and office decorations.

offices.title: Your offices
offices.body: Your own office and every team office you've joined. Create a team office to get an invite code, or Join one with a teammate's code — you'll walk right in.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Created automatically, no sign-up. Settings → Account shows your recovery code: keep it safe to restore your character, coins and offices on another computer.

guide.title: Need a hand?
guide.body: The guide explains everything step by step, including how to connect Claude Code. You can replay this tour from there.
